s.note: a mutton, lettuce and tomato sandwich, the lean mutton kind
s.how: Sear a 400g lamb backstrap to pink, rest and slice thin. Toast 8 slices sourdough. Mix 100g mayo with chopped mint. Build with crisp cos, ripe tomato and the lamb. When the mutton is nice and lean.

s.note: Miracle Max says the chocolate coating makes it go down easier
s.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate with a pinch of flaky salt. Stir smooth and chill 3 hours. Roll into small balls and coat in cocoa. Have fun storming the castle.

m.note: for the giant with the big appetite
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck, add 2 onions, thyme and 375ml ale and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken and pour into a big pie dish. Cover with 2 sheets puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter, whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in three tins at 170C for 25 minutes. Melt 200g caramels with cream for filling. Stack tall and spread ganache of 150g chocolate and 150ml cream roughly over the sides.

d.how: Pour a medium-bodied red into goblets and swap them around the table. Pour red grape juice for anyone who can't decide which cup to choose. Never go in against a Sicilian when death is on the line.
